title_en: CPC Central Political Bureau Holds Meeting to Decide on Fifth Plenary Session and Analyze Economic Situation
summary_zh: 中共中央总书记习近平主持召开中共中央政治局会议，决定召开二十届五中全会，并分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作。
summary_en: Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, deciding to convene the 5th Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee and reviewing current economic conditions.
